info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Market Analysi Analyse-spec
info.description: The Market Analysis Submission API enables businesses to submit detailed market analyses for evaluation and review. By utilizing this endpoint, users can provide insights, trends, and research findings that contribute to strategic decision-making. This API is particularly useful for financial institutions, market analysts, and business strategists looking to enhance their market intelligence. The service facilitates streamlined analysis submissions, thereby ensuring that key stakeholders have access to up-to-date market information.

post.description: This operation allows you to create a new market analysis record. Provide the necessary data in the request body to generate insights for your business strategies.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new market analysis. It should contain all required fields to properly define the analysis being submitted for processing.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the analysis data is returned.

CreateMarketAnalysiAnalyseRequest.title: Market Analysis Request Body

segmentId.description: Identifier for the market segment being analyzed.

scenario.description: Description of the market scenario for the analysis.

CreateMarketAnalysiAnalyseRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for creating a market analysis operation. This includes identifiers, time periods, currency information, scenario details, and request context.
